HoMM5 Widescreen Patch

Install

1. Close the games.
2. Copy dinput8.dll next to each H5_Game.exe:
   - GOG Heroes V: bin\ and bina1\
   - GOG Tribes of the East: bin\
   - Steam Heroes V: bin\
   - Steam Hammers of Fate: bina1\
   - Steam Tribes of the East: bin\
   "Open folders" in the patcher opens the folders of the checked games and the folder where source dinput8.dll is located.
3. Run homm5-widescreen-patch.exe. If the games are under Program Files, run it as administrator.
4. Check the games to patch, choose the options and click Install.
5. Start a new mission or map. Saved games keep the old UI layout.

Uninstall

Run homm5-widescreen-patch.exe, check the games and click Uninstall. It also removes dinput8.dll.

Before switching the game language (GOG Galaxy, or Properties > Language in Steam), uninstall the patch. Install it again afterwards.
